metric: executemany 20,000 rows in 12.8 s → 1,561 rows/s; json+read 20,000 rows in 0.02 s → 1,064,909 rows/s; ratio 682x
observation: A first benchmark was reported as DuckDB being unusable at 1,586 rows/s for extraction. The correction, on request, was that executemany executes the statement once per row, so the figure measures per-statement overhead; the same rows loaded through NDJSON and one read_json reached about 1.06M rows/s.
